description: Finalize a custody mode change (ADR-003, decision 5). signer = pds: checks the possession proofs, signs and submits the update, reads it back. signer = user: the user already submitted it; checks PLC holds exactly that operation as the latest. Then stores or deletes this server's key shares and updates the mode. Idempotent.

userRotationDidKey.description: Towards the person (from custodial): the user's new rotation key.

ownerDidKey.description: Towards the person (from custodial): the user's owner key.

pdsRotationDidKey.description: Towards the PDS: the key prepare reserved (returned as pdsRotationDidKey).

possession.description: signer = pds: { rotation: OwnerSignature, owner: OwnerSignature } over possessionText.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: Missing or invalid input, or the account is already in that mode.

errors.name: CustodyModeNotAllowed
errors.description: This server does not allow the target mode.

errors.name: NotCustodial
errors.description: This server holds no rotation key for the account.

errors.name: NotSubmitted
errors.description: The user-signed operation is not at PLC yet.

errors.name: OperationMismatch
errors.description: The operation does not match this change; prepare again.

errors.name: StateChanged
errors.description: The DID changed after this operation.

errors.name: PossessionProofInvalid
errors.description: The new keys' signatures are missing or wrong.

errors.name: PdsKeyNotReserved
errors.description: The key prepare reserved is gone.

errors.name: UpstreamFailure
errors.description: The PLC directory refused or does not show the update yet.
